githubIntro: Connect your account to use selected repositories, issues, and pull requests.
githubNotConfigured: GitHub is not configured in this build. Update to an official release that supports this connection.
githubStatusFailed: Could not check the GitHub connection.
githubWaiting: Complete GitHub authorization in your browser…
githubCancelled: Connection cancelled. You can try again.
githubExpired: Connection timed out. Please try again.
githubAuthorizationFailed: GitHub authorization did not complete. Please reconnect.
githubRetryHint: Could not continue yet. Retrying the connection; you can also continue the task later.
githubActionFailed: Could not complete this action. Refresh and retry. If the task changed, request GitHub again in the current conversation.
githubChooseHint: Install Kun Desktop on GitHub and select the repositories to allow. Your task will continue automatically.
githubConsent: Connecting allows this conversation’s configured models to process GitHub data you request. This connection provides read access only.
githubDataPolicy: Requested code, issues, pull requests and related conversation context can be processed by the configured models, including routing and failover. Data may remain in local history and appear through remote access you enable. Model services have different data policies. GitHub user tokens remain encrypted locally and never enter model prompts. Disconnecting deletes local credentials; revoke GitHub-side authorization in GitHub Settings → Applications.
